name: AFFIN Bank Berhad
summary: AFFIN Bank Berhad, a financial holding company, provides various banking services in Malaysia. It operates through Commercial Banking, Investment Banking, Insurance, and Others segments. The Commercial Banking segment offers savings and fixed deposits, remittance services, current accounts, vehicle loans/financing, hire purchase, housing loans/financing, overdrafts/cashlines and personal loans/financing, treasury, credit cards, unit trusts, and bancassurance/bancatakaful products; financial products and services for corporates, public sector, and small and medium enterprises, including long-term loans/financing, project and equipment financing, overdrafts and trade financing, and other fee-b…
